comments.value: Update: I have rigged up a Kinect to see if that would fix the issue and it did not, but after moving back from the Kinect to regular VR the issue magically fixed itself but than came back after a few world swaps. I have no idea what is causing this misalignment but since it just keeps happening i'm going to keep playing with the Kinect and trying to fix this issue. I have tried Driver4VR(Paid) and KinectToVR yet they both produce the issue. Even with a fresh install of the game/file integrity verify, the issue still happens, trying to hold something shows it fine on my screen but on other peoples screen my hand is high and off to my left more. No amount of calibration or offsetting has fixed this issue. It happens with every avatar and is most prominent with the robot ones where the arm is disconnected from the shoulder.

Update 2: I am not sure what caused this issue on regular VR but the issue is now narrowed down to a VR to VR FBT issue. As I have uploaded some new avatars that I have ONLY used in FBT they work normal and look normal; but if I use an Avatar that I used with ONLY VR then hop onto VR with FBT the neck is misaligned, the arm/shoulder is tore and the torso is bent out of proportion. I have tried a fresh install of the game, deleting local cache, and deleting all local data. The only thing I have not tried is deleting the entire VRChat folder on steam and installing the game again. But aslong as i'm on an Avatar that I have used with FBT on the first time I used it, the issue is not present. As for the issue happening with no FBT, I have zero clue but it has not happened a 3rd time after setting up "Dedicated" FBT avatars I have to use and "Dedicated" VR without FBT avatars. Although I would like to be able to interchange them between VR and VR FBT this seems the closest I will get: and no, I don't plan on seeing if going from FBT to just VR produces the same issue due to the risk of corrupting the avatars that I have working fine with FBT. If any progression is made on fixing this issue/narrowing the problem down further, I will update this thread again.

Update 3: This issue seems to have some sort of hidden embedding into the computer that saves what avatars you have previously used and what sort of tracking you have on used when you used it. I have tried using a whole new account with FBT to see if it was something linked to my account but that didn't fix the issue either, but avatars I have never used worked perfectly fine. I also tried using a VPN on both accounts in case it was an IP issue (Unsure how but i'm trying everything) but that did not fix the issue. The only thing I can think of is that there is some sort of link between the avatars you have used and the tracking they where first used with, maybe some kind of hidden folder on the computer, if so, it would be as simple as deleting that and "Using" an avatar "For the first time" so a new folder and avatar tracking is saved in it. So my next course of action is going to be trying to run FBT VR on my 2nd computer which has a 750Ti, doubtful it will even run but I just need to try it for narrowing down if its the computer or if it is something server side. If the computer doesn't run it then its a coin flip between Avatars you have used previously saved on; Your Computer or; VRChat Servers. But I figure if the issue is happening on a New account, the information is stacked more towards the computer. I would think after deleting every VRChat file, that the issue would go away but apparently some files must not get deleted if that's the case. I also can not launch the Oculus version of VRChat and test it since FBT is done through Steam VR. I will update this thread if I get the 2nd PC to run VRChat and FBT, here's hoping.
EDIT: I have tried installing the game on a different HDD and the issue still persist. Proceeding to check every file name on my computer for a VRChat or Avatar folder. I'd assume its in %appdata% since most of those files don't get touched.

details: I use an Oculus Rift, Not S, and for no reason on my side of the game it appears as my shoulder is stretched or misplaced from my avatar. I'm not sure what caused this but its only on my side and my friends say it looks normal in game. Happens with every avatar besides ones with LARGE shoulders. Its quite annoying to have a floating arm.
title: Shoulder Tear/Disconnect
